fields.statement: QA at 29929ba with this commit's built rhiza: go test TestScripts/build-workflow and run-ship-change(-fail) pass. In a scratch repo on a branch, committed a capability, then left a landed actor record (rhiza add actor --record) and an Evidence entry uncommitted, so rhiza check failed (rendered folder stale/missing). Ran build.toml's [step.render] command verbatim with RHIZA_CHANGE set: exit 0, one new commit 'Render after the build' with 'Change: <change id>', holding both log entries and the rendered actor pages and index; git status empty and rhiza check prints ok afterwards.

QA at 29929ba with this commit's built rhiza: go test TestScripts/review-workflow passes (asserts 'Render after the review' last, clean .rhiza status and rhiza check on the branch). In a scratch repo with a landed actor record and an Evidence entry left uncommitted (rhiza check failing), ran review.toml's [step.render] command verbatim: exit 0, one commit 'Render after the review' with 'Change: <change id>', holding the log entries and rendered pages; git status empty and rhiza check ok after.

QA at 29929ba with this commit's built rhiza: after each scratch repo's render commit, re-ran the same build/review render command: exit 0, HEAD unchanged, git status empty. On a fresh clone of the branch head 29929ba (rhiza check ok), ran both build and review render commands verbatim: 'Rendered 1501 files (0 written, 0 removed, 1501 unchanged)', both exit 0, HEAD unchanged, no working-tree changes.
